section_title: Other AFC regulations that impact organizations > Major ABC regulations

propositions.proposition: FCPA禁止美国人和特定外国证券发行人向外国政府官员支付款项以获取或保留业务。
source_quotes: Under this law, it is illegal for all US persons and certain foreign securities issuers to make payments to foreign government officials to assist them in obtaining or retaining business.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 禁止向外国政府官员支付款项

evidence_spans.quote: Under this law, it is illegal for all US persons and certain foreign securities issuers to make payments to foreign government officials to assist them in obtaining or retaining business.

propositions.proposition: 自1998年起，FCPA也适用于在美国境内直接或间接实施腐败行为的外国公司和个人。
source_quotes: Since 1998, it has also applied to foreign firms and persons who, directly or indirectly, cause acts of corruption within the US.

trigger_or_context: 外国公司或个人在美国境内直接或间接实施腐败行为
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: FCPA法律适用于该外国公司或个人

evidence_spans.quote: Since 1998, it has also applied to foreign firms and persons who, directly or indirectly, cause acts of corruption within the US.

propositions.proposition: 《外国敲诈预防技术修正案》将外国官员及其代理人收受贿赂定为犯罪。
source_quotes: the Foreign Extortion Prevention Technical Corrections Act complements the FCPA by criminalizing the acceptance of bribes by foreign officials and their agents.

trigger_or_context: 外国官员及其代理人收受贿赂

evidence_spans.quote: the Foreign Extortion Prevention Technical Corrections Act complements the FCPA by criminalizing the acceptance of bribes by foreign officials and their agents.

propositions.proposition: FCPA的贿赂条款通常豁免仅为加快例行公务行动而支付的便利费。
source_quotes: the FCPA’s bribery provisions generally exempt facilitation payments if they are made solely to expedite a routine official action that would occur even without the payment.

trigger_or_context: 支付便利费以加快例行公务行动
basis_or_condition: 支付仅为加快例行公务行动且即使不支付也会发生
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 豁免该便利费，不适用FCPA贿赂条款

evidence_spans.quote: the FCPA’s bribery provisions generally exempt facilitation payments if they are made solely to expedite a routine official action that would occur even without the payment.

propositions.proposition: 英国《2010年反贿赂法》对通过关联人实施贿赂的商业实体引入严格责任，除非该实体能证明有充分的防贿赂保障措施。
source_quotes: It also introduced strict liability for commercial entities that engage in bribery through associated persons, unless the entity can demonstrate it has sufficient anti-bribery safeguards.

trigger_or_context: 商业实体通过关联人实施贿赂
basis_or_condition: 除非实体能证明有充分的防贿赂保障措施
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 商业实体承担严格责任

evidence_spans.quote: It also introduced strict liability for commercial entities that engage in bribery through associated persons, unless the entity can demonstrate it has sufficient anti-bribery safeguards.

propositions.proposition: 根据英国政府法定指导意见，反贿赂保障措施必须包括相称程序、高层承诺、风险评估、尽职调查、培训沟通以及监测审查。
source_quotes: these safeguards must include proportionate procedures, senior management commitment, risk assessment, due diligence, communication that includes training, and monitoring and review.

trigger_or_context: 存在反贿赂保障措施要求
basis_or_condition: 英国政府法定指导意见
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 保障措施必须包含六大要素

evidence_spans.quote: these safeguards must include proportionate procedures, senior management commitment, risk assessment, due diligence, communication that includes training, and monitoring and review.

propositions.proposition: Sapin II要求大型公司和公共实体制定符合特定标准的反腐败计划。
source_quotes: For large companies and public entities, Sapin II introduced an obligation to have an anticorruption program meeting specific criteria.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 必须制定符合特定标准的反腐败计划

evidence_spans.quote: For large companies and public entities, Sapin II introduced an obligation to have an anticorruption program meeting specific criteria.

propositions.proposition: 法国反腐败局可实施行政处罚并将调查结果移送国家金融检察官办公室。
source_quotes: This agency can impose administrative penalties and refer findings to the National Financial Prosecutor’s Office.

trigger_or_context: 存在腐败相关调查结果
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 法国反腐败局实施行政处罚或移送检察官

evidence_spans.quote: This agency can impose administrative penalties and refer findings to the National Financial Prosecutor’s Office.

propositions.proposition: Sapin II创建了通过暂缓起诉协议解决腐败案件的新机制。
source_quotes: Sapin II created a novel mechanism for resolving corruption cases through deferred prosecution agreements.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 适用暂缓起诉协议机制解决

evidence_spans.quote: Sapin II created a novel mechanism for resolving corruption cases through deferred prosecution agreements.
